purpose.domain_detail: JMA (Japan Medical Association) ORCA standard medical receipt software - monthly insurance claim aggregation/printing for national health insurance (kokuho) and other insurers
purpose.summary: SOKATU1010 is a batch program in the JMA ORCA medical receipt system that performs monthly insurance claim (seikyu-sho) aggregation processing. It reads a temporary claim file, updates a receipt DB update file, handles error files, and produces printed output for national health insurance billing. It supports disaster-response patient separation and online return processing.

notable_features: 48 CALL statements indicating heavy use of subprogram library
UNSTRING of COMMAND-PARAM for parameter parsing
LINKAGE SECTION with COMMAND-PARAM (called as subprogram or via shell)
INDEXED and LINE SEQUENTIAL file organizations
Japanese EUC-JP encoded comments (latin-1 decoded as mojibake)
Revision history spanning 2005-2011 with named maintainers
INITIALIZE of SPA-AREA (scratchpad area pattern common in ORCA)
verdict.notes: File is encoded in EUC-JP; decoded as latin-1 causing mojibake in Japanese comment text. Source is truncated at 16000 chars out of 119201 bytes total. The program is clearly part of the well-known open-source JMA ORCA medical receipt system. Dialect is GnuCOBOL (open-cobol) as explicitly noted in revision history entry 01.00.13.
